paper.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale

result.summary: 本文提出 Vision Transformer（ViT），将图像切分为固定大小的 patch 序列，直接送入标准 Transformer 编码器进行图像分类，几乎不引入图像特有的归纳偏置 [S1.p3][S5.p1]。作者在 ImageNet、ImageNet-21k、JFT-300M 等不同规模数据集上预训练，并迁移到 ImageNet、CIFAR-100、VTAB 等多个基准 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。结果显示，在中小数据集上 ViT 略逊于同规模 ResNet，但在大规模数据预训练后 ViT 可达到或超过当时最优卷积网络，且预训练所需计算资源更少 [S1.p4][S1.p5][S4.SS2.p2]。作者认为这表明对 CNN 的依赖并非必要，纯 Transformer 直接处理图像 patch 序列即可在图像分类上表现良好 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中卷积架构仍占主导，能否将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像，而不依赖卷积网络或专门的注意力近似 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。作者指出，此前将自注意力用于图像的工作要么与 CNN 结合，要么替换 CNN 的某些组件但保留整体结构，而纯注意力模型因使用专门注意力模式尚未在现代硬件上有效扩展 [S1.p2]。其动机来自 Transformer 在 NLP 中的成功与可扩展性，希望以尽可能少的修改把标准 Transformer 用于图像 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: In computer vision, however, convolutional architectures remain dominant.
The latter models, while theoretically efficient, have not yet been scaled effectively on modern hardware accelerators due to the use of specialized attention patterns.
Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.
In vision, attention is either applied in conjunction with convolutional networks, or used to replace certain components of convolutional networks while keeping their overall structure in place.

method.text: 方法上，ViT 将图像 \(\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}\) 切分为 \(N=HW/P^{2}\) 个 \(P\times P\) 的 patch，展平后经可训练线性投影映射到维度 \(D\)，得到 patch embeddings [S3.SS1.p1]。与 BERT 类似，在序列前加入可学习的 [class] token，其编码器输出作为图像表示用于分类 [S3.SS1.p2]。位置信息通过标准可学习 1D 位置嵌入加入，编码器由多头自注意力和 MLP 交替组成，每个 block 前用 LayerNorm、后接残差连接 [S3.SS1.p3][S3.SS1.p4]。微调时移除预训练预测头，接零初始化 \(D\times K\) 前馈层，并可在更高分辨率下对预训练位置嵌入做 2D 插值 [S3.SS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: we reshape the image $\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}$ into a sequence of flattened 2D patches $\mathbf{x}_{p}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times(P^{2}\cdot C)}$
we flatten the patches and map to $D$ dimensions with a trainable linear projection (Eq. 1).
Similar to BERT’s [class] token, we prepend a learnable embedding to the sequence of embedded patches
Position embeddings are added to the patch embeddings to retain positional information.
The Transformer encoder consists of alternating layers of multiheaded self-attention (MSA, see Appendix A) and MLP blocks
we remove the pre-trained prediction head and attach a zero-initialized $D\times K$ feedforward layer
We therefore perform 2D interpolation of the pre-trained position embeddings, according to their location in the original image.

experiments.text: 实验在 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 图像）上预训练，并迁移到 ImageNet、ImageNet-ReaL、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102 以及 19 任务 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。模型变体基于 BERT 配置，包括 Base、Large 和新增的 Huge，并用 ViT-L/16 等记号表示模型大小与 patch 大小 [S4.SS1.p3]。基线 CNN 使用将 BatchNorm 替换为 GroupNorm 的 ResNet（ResNet (BiT)），混合模型则把 CNN 特征图作为 ViT 输入 [S4.SS1.p4]。训练使用 Adam、batch size 4096、权重衰减 0.1，微调使用 SGD with momentum、batch size 512 [S4.SS1.p5]。

evidence.quote: we use the ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset with 1k classes and 1.3M images
its superset ImageNet-21k with 21k classes and 14M images, and JFT with 18k classes and 303M high-resolution images.
We also evaluate on the 19-task VTAB classification suite.
We base ViT configurations on those used for BERT, as summarized in Table 1.
For the baseline CNNs, we use ResNet, but replace the Batch Normalization layers with Group Normalization
We train all models, including ResNets, using Adam with $\beta_{1}=0.9$, $\beta_{2}=0.999$, a batch size of 4096 and apply a high weight decay of $0.1$

findings.text: 在中小数据集上，ViT 在 ImageNet 上比同规模 ResNet 低几个百分点，作者认为这可能是因为 Transformer 缺少 CNN 的平移等变性和局部性等归纳偏置，数据不足时泛化不佳 [S1.p4]。但在更大数据集（14M–300M 图像）上，大规模训练胜过归纳偏置：ViT 在 ImageNet-21k 或 JFT-300M 预训练后接近或超过多个基准的最优结果，最佳模型达到 ImageNet 88.55%、ImageNet-ReaL 90.72%、CIFAR-100 94.55%、VTAB 19 任务 77.63% [S1.p5]。在 JFT-300M 上预训练的 ViT-L/16 在所有任务上超过同样预训练的 BiT-L，且所需计算资源显著更少；ViT-H/14 进一步提升，尤其在 ImageNet、CIFAR-100 和 VTAB 上 [S4.SS2.p2]。缩放研究中，ViT 在性能/计算权衡上优于 ResNet，约用 2–4 倍更少计算达到相同性能，混合模型在小计算预算下略优于纯 ViT，但差距随模型增大消失 [S4.SS4.p2]。

evidence.quote: these models yield modest accuracies of a few percentage points below ResNets of comparable size.
Transformers lack some of the inductive biases inherent to CNNs, such as translation equivariance and locality, and therefore do not generalize well when trained on insufficient amounts of data.
We find that large scale training trumps inductive bias.
the best model reaches the accuracy of $88.55\%$ on ImageNet, $90.72\%$ on ImageNet-ReaL, $94.55\%$ on CIFAR-100, and $77.63\%$ on the VTAB suite of 19 tasks.
The smaller ViT-L/16 model pre-trained on JFT-300M outperforms BiT-L (which is pre-trained on the same dataset) on all tasks, while requiring substantially less computational resources to train.
ViT uses approximately $2-4\times$ less compute to attain the same performance (average over 5 datasets).
hybrids slightly outperform ViT at small computational budgets, but the difference vanishes for larger models.

limitations.text: 作者承认仍有许多挑战：一是将 ViT 应用到检测、分割等其他视觉任务；二是继续探索自监督预训练方法，其初步实验显示自监督预训练有提升，但与大规模监督预训练之间仍有较大差距 [S5.p2]。此外，作者指出预训练效率可能不仅受架构选择影响，还受训练计划、优化器、权重衰减等其他参数影响 [S4.SS2.p2]。在自监督部分，作者也说明其初步探索中 ViT-B/16 自监督预训练达到 79.9% ImageNet 准确率，比从头训练提升 2%，但仍落后监督预训练 4%，并将对比式预训练留作未来工作 [S4.SS6.p1]。

evidence.quote: One is to apply ViT to other computer vision tasks, such as detection and segmentation.
Another challenge is to continue exploring self-supervised pre-training methods.
Our initial experiments show improvement from self-supervised pre-training, but there is still large gap between self-supervised and large-scale supervised pre-training.
we note that pre-training efficiency may be affected not only by the architecture choice, but also other parameters, such as training schedule, optimizer, weight decay, etc.
our smaller ViT-B/16 model achieves 79.9% accuracy on ImageNet, a significant improvement of 2% to training from scratch, but still 4% behind supervised pre-training.
We leave exploration of contrastive pre-training to future work.
